sisi.depan: The far curved wall is dominated by a junction of large, glowing mako energy pipes and a single, oversized pressure gauge.
sisi.kanan: On the right wall, a bank of flickering, wall-mounted monitors is set beside a heavy, sealed maintenance access hatch.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, a massive, circular blast door with an adjacent security keypad serves as the room's only entrance.
sisi.kiri: An industrial metal catwalk with a safety railing runs along the left wall, leading up towards an unseen level above periodic steam vents.

tengah: In the absolute center, the tall, cylindrical reactor core pulses with a soft blue light, and at its base, a semi-circular control console faces towards the camera.
atas: Overhead, a complex web of thick power conduits and structural gantries converges on a central point high above the reactor, from which a single, powerful spotlight shines down.
